$comment: Canonical lifecycle failure codes of the tenant control plane. Owned by Console; Admin and LobeHub (CPC) keep byte-identical copies at the same path. Edit here, copy to both, then run `bun run contracts:check` in Console. A failed tenant-lifecycle POST answers action_required with 409 and retryable with 503 + Retry-After. Market produces the codes whose producers list it, under its own contract (market-control-plane.json) and holds no copy of this file.
